messages:
sasha: Quick follow-up from the auth-service postmortem — recurring pattern: short 2-4m blips causing pages + a separate long-tail >12m degradation. Need concise owners for tuning and remediation tracking.

sasha: Proposed actions:
- A1: Add hysteresis to auth-timeout alert (avoid paging on transient spikes).
- A2: Extend dedupe window specifically for auth-timeout alerts and add fingerprinting by trace_id.
- A3: Add 'snooze' policy for non-prod traffic 22:00-07:00.
- A4: Update runbook with rollback steps + quick verification checklist.
- A5: Create a dashboard tile with burn rate for auth errors and a CI smoke job that simulates bursty traffic.

liam: I can take A1 (hysteresis). Thinking: require p99 > 700ms for 3/5 windows (5m each) before paging. Will prototype query and post here. ETA: 18h.

oliver: I'll own A2 (dedupe + fingerprint). Current dedupe is 90s. Recommend 7m for auth-timeout but keep an immediate escalation path if sustained for 8+ mins. ETA: 48h.

pagerbot: Ticket created: OPS-7782 "auth-service alert hysteresis & dedupe" -> assigned oliver.

nina: I'll do A4 runbook edits and add the CI check spec (example curl + load profile). ETA: EOD.

sasha: For A5 can someone add the dashboard tile? Need a burn-rate widget + links to traces.

carla: I can add the dashboard tile and wire the trace link. ETA: 6h.

liam: snippet for the hysteresis query I mentioned:
```
avg_over_time(prometheus.p99_auth_latency[15m])
```
Plan: test in staging with 5m rolling windows, then push to prod.

oliver: note: when we fingerprint by trace_id we should ignore bot-originated traces to avoid false dedupe. Will add label check.

sasha: Good call. Also we must track these as action items in the postmortem tracker. Please add PR links / ticket numbers once you have them.

carla: PR for dashboard: https://redwood/repo/dash/PR-894, will merge after review.

oliver: OPS-7783 created for dedupe tweak + fingerprint rule. Linking in tracker.

nina: Runbook PR: https://redwood/docs/runbooks/auth-rollbacks#pr-22 (includes CI spec).

liam: Quick ask: when we add hysteresis, can we keep a separate noisy-alert metric to feed into ML-based alert scoring later? cc @sre-platform.

sasha: Noted. We'll add a line item for follow-up: explore ML scoring in 2-week backlog.

carla: Owners recap: liam=A1(18h), oliver=A2(48h), carla=A5(6h), nina=A4(EOD). Sasha will maintain tracker.

sasha: Thanks — reconvene in 36h here for status updates. If blocked ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
